task_name: C3-H3: Tight deadline but books intake
intent: Open with exactly: "A car pulled out of a driveway and hit my passenger side." When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Wesley Trombley." State is California; it happened in Ventura. You are the caller: never ask the agent questions about the accident. You were driving your own car. If asked about injuries or losses: pain in your right side and shoulder, and damage to the passenger side of your car. If asked about treatment: no medical treatment yet. Date: September fifteenth, twenty twenty four. Stay until they confirm the intake is recorded and the new-client packet is on the file. A spoken promise without both on the file is not enough. If asked for your email address, give it: nadine dot carlisle at example dot com. Accept the packet by email if offered. If offered a free case evaluation or appointment, decline booking. Do not ask for a person. Never say "Thank you, that's all I needed." in answer to a question about the state, the date, or the other side; answer the question instead. After they confirm intake is recorded and the packet is on the file, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." Do not book an evaluation. End the call.

The agent asks you to repeat, confirm, or say one digit at a time your callback number, or only some of its digits such as the first six or last four. NOT when asking for your name.
scripted_responses.response_value: Eight, zero, five, five, five, five, zero, one, six, seven.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone. NOT any other question.

The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, or who this would be against. NOT when asking for your name or number. NOT any other question. This includes a question that comes after a filler, a thank-you, or a statement in the same turn, such as one moment, checking, a result they just looked up, a fee, or a disclaimer.
The agent asks which state this happened in. NOT when asking which city or where in California. NOT any other question.

The agent asks when the incident happened, or for the date of the accident, injury or event. NOT any other question. This includes a question that comes after a filler, a thank-you, or a statement in the same turn, such as one moment, checking, a result they just looked up, a fee, or a disclaimer.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was September fifteenth, twenty twenty four.
